newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse recovers as bearish mood lifts.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse recovers as bearish mood lifts.

text.p: Prices on the Bucharest bourse recovered marginally on Thursday, although trading remained relatively quiet due to a summer holiday mood, brokers said.
Newcomer first-tier stock Otel Inox was the star of the day's activity, registering a leap of 33,000 lei to close at 53,000 after being subject to high demand immediately after trade opened.
"Some first and second-tier prices rose under sudden strong demand but we do not expect the market to turn back to a bullish phase," one trader said.
Operators said the market might remain steady on Friday, with only slight changes. Prices had generally eased on Wednesday.
The closing prices of 25 stocks were higher while 15 fell and six were flat. Two stocks stayed suspended and three had no trades.
Three independent market indices, the VAB, the BIG and the CAS-SE, based on average prices and market capitalisation, rose by 0.4, 0.22 and 0.42 percent respectively from Wednesday.
Brokers Otel Inox, which joined the trading on Thursday, was the object of furious activity but could be subject to profit-taking at forthcoming sessions.
"Buying pressure was huge on Otel Inox throughout the day and the price hit peak after peak to stop at 53,000 lei," one broker said of Thursday's trading.
Also on the first tier, fertiliser maker Azomures and chemical plant Oltchim made gains. Azomures closed 150 lei higher at 3,650. Oltchim was 100 lei up to 4,000.
Pharmaceutical plant Terapia was also among the gainers, closing 400 lei firmer at 9,300, while Antibiotice, another drugs maker, finished at 7,300 lei from previous session, after opening at 7,500.
The second tier was led by engineering plant Armatura, up 250 lei at 6,150, and drilling equipment maker Ciprom, up 660 lei in late trading to 1,400.
Turnover rose at 7.41 billion lei from 7.03 previously.
